question: Tribal Welfare Ministers in Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha are appointed by the __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Governor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tribal Welfare Ministers in Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, and Odisha are appointed by the Governor.
 
• The Governor is the constitutional head of a state in India.
 
• The appointment of ministers, including Tribal Welfare Ministers, is made based on the advice of the Chief Minister.
 
• Governors have the authority to appoint and dismiss ministers in their respective states.
 
• The role of the Tribal Welfare Minister is to address and manage policies and programs related to tribal communities in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chief Minister**

 
 
• The Chief Minister is the head of the government in a state and is responsible for the day-to-day functioning of the state administration.
 
• The Chief Minister advises the Governor on the appointment of ministers.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister**
 
 
• The Prime Minister is the head of the government at the national level in India.
 
• While the Prime Minister has significant influence in national matters, the appointment of state ministers is not within their direct jurisdiction.
 
 
 
• **Tribal Development Council**
 
 
• This is an advisory body that focuses on the development and welfare of tribal communities.
 
• The council provides recommendations and guidance on policies, but does not have the authority to appoint ministers.
